Method of Attack: Trojanized supply chain attack replacing two DLLs with malicious versions that download additional malware such as information-stealing trojan
Attack Vector: Compromise of 3CX Windows desktop application supply chain; Modified DLL exploiting CVE-2013-3900 WinVerifyTrust Signature Validation Vulnerability
Indicators of Compromise: Malicious d3dcompiler_47.dll DLL with encrypted payload appended but still showing valid Microsoft signature due to CVE-2013-3900
Registry keys EnableCertPaddingCheck required to detect modification
Removal of fix after upgrading to Windows 11
